column1: # tests/spinel-bpf-mlir/tests.tsv -- every Go test function of tools/spinel-bpf-mlir,
# under one class, so tests/spinel-bpf-mlir/run.sh can run the routine ones and
# refuse to run with a test it does not know.
#   package  the Go package directory under tools/spinel-bpf-mlir
#   class    routine           runs in run.sh with no privilege and no oracle
#            privileged        reaches sudoCmd (a load or attach as root);
#                              not run until the owner names the lane
#            vm                boots a kernel image under $HOME/kernel-build
#                              (SPINELBPF_VM=1); kept as a file, not run here
#            oracle-committed  compares with, or reads, the generated outputs
#            pending           waits for the owner's decision on the driver's
#                              Spinel commit check; the note says how
#            absent            needs a file of the source that was not imported
# Shape: this file lists the public shape, the one this tree builds: no
# The class was first derived from each test's call graph within its package
# (test files only): reaching sudoCmd, sudo or Geteuid is privileged,
# SPINELBPF_VM is vm, a comparison with a committed output is
# oracle-committed, SPINELBPF_CRUBY or a ruby exec is oracle-cruby. A test
# that compares the kernel with the native twin the same frontend generates
# stays within one implementation and is not an oracle; those tests are
# privileged anyway. A class changed after the first run says why in its note.
